decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the core agency service, costs little to maintain, and earns recurring revenue, so there is no reason to drop it even though it was not observed after 2019.
The version management tool builds on the firm's developer tooling and is cheap to keep running, and its value for agencies is plausible, so the option stays open.
The GDPR contract tool is distant from the core offer and its post-GDPR demand has likely leveled off, but upkeep of a web tool is minimal, so keeping it remains slightly preferable to abandoning it.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship that defines the firm's strategic direction, so it warrants continued commitment rather than abandonment.
